title: Susan Gough says Gimbal is not a training video

tellings.quote: I asked Susan Goant and she told me it wasn't a training video.

plain: The Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy cockpit recording made off Florida that shows an unidentified object, is not a training video, according to Susan Gough, a Pentagon spokesperson. The UFO skeptic Mick West, who analyses such videos, says on the show that he asked Gough directly and "she told me it wasn't a training video", which, if so, rules out one simple explanation for where the footage came from.
